lines: Devang Mehta, an Investor Selling Shareholder, is selling up to 16,650 shares in the offer for sale.
Up to ₹2.25 crore if all offered shares are sold; the event was 67 days ago, and timing is in hand since 11 Mar 2026.
Retained shares of ₹5.25 crore (estimate, valued at offer price) have been unlocked since 9 Sep 2026, so more value remains for later discussion.
